text: Proven Leadership Delivering Results

As parents of two young children, my wife and I understand the challenges San Diego families face — rising costs for groceries, utilities, and housing. On the City Council, I’ve focused on practical leadership that strengthens fiscal accountability, expands housing opportunities, and delivers real improvements across our neighborhoods.
First-Term Accomplishments
Repaved more than 95 miles of neighborhood streets, including the reconstruction of Gold Coast Drive

Delivered more than $70 million in neighborhood investments across our district, including Marcy Park improvements in University City; a new Aquatic Center, All-Wheels Park, and recreation center upgrades at Mira Mesa Community Park; the Epicentre Youth Center revitalization through a City–County partnership; and the Convoy District gateway sign
Led budget efforts that restored library and recreation center hours, preserved arts funding, and expanded housing opportunities for working families
Focused on Results
Responsible fiscal leadership and government accountability
Expanding housing opportunities for working families
Investing in safer neighborhoods and better streets, parks, and libraries
Endorsed by:

text: As a first-generation American whose family came to San Diego as refugees, I understand hard work and sacrifice. Today, the city I love has become unaffordable for hardworking San Diegans and I want to help turn that around.

I’m running because we need a representative who will listen to our community, fight for our priorities, and fix what’s broken. Our tax dollars should fund core services: repair roads, keep public restrooms open, protect neighborhoods, enforce public encampment laws, and preserve libraries and park/rec centers for families and seniors. Other priorities include:
Oppose new taxes and fees.
Prioritize fixing roads and sidewalks.
Protect neighborhoods from negative ADU impacts.
Preserve street parking for residents and local businesses.
Remove dead trees from canyons to reduce fire risk.
Expand opportunities for affordable homeownership.
Direct more funding for neighborhood services.
Background:
Teacher, Vice Principal, Professor
Former SDPD Reserve Officer
Former elected County Board of Education member
Built a successful real estate brokerage over 25 years
Endorsements:
Mitz Lee: Mira Mesa Community Leader/Advocate, Former School Board member
Bonnie Kutch: Founder UC Neighbors for Responsible Growth (UC PEEPS)
Ruth DeSantis: University City Community Leader/Advocate
Lorie Zapf: Two-term City Councilmember
Mark and his wife have two young adult daughters.
